source.author: verg
source.text: Maxima res effecta, viri; timor omnis abesto, quod superest: haec sunt spolia et de rege superbo primitiae, manibusque meis Mezentius hic est.
source.text_original: 'Maxima res effecta, viri; timor omnis abesto, / quod superest: haec sunt spolia et de rege superbo / primitiae, manibusque meis Mezentius hic est.
source.text_english: The greatest feat has been accomplished, men; let all fear be gone. What remains: these are the spoils and the first-fruits taken from the proud king, and by my own hands this Mezentius is here.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_original: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque / cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_english: Let the mountains and forests and lakes and all the barriers of the sea be laid open; let hope and fear be for all.
